objective: Preallocate synchronous WAL batch clone buffers from the known input slice length.

tasks.title: Preallocate WAL append batch clone buffer
tasks.result: WalManager::append_batch now preallocates the owned WAL entry vector from entries.len() before cloning the input slice.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was full.
The change preserves WAL entry order and Put/Delete clone semantics while avoiding implicit vector growth in the sync append_batch wrapper.
